## Overview

The Business Domain contains patterns that define and optimize business capabilities that drive organizational value and strategic outcomes. These patterns bridge business requirements with technical implementation.

Per the [Enterprise Architecture Practice Overview](../../foundation/practice-overview.md), the Business Domain focuses on:

- Business Capabilities
- Business Requirements Translation
- Capability Road-mapping
- Value Stream Optimization
- Business Process Architecture

page_texts.14:
[patterns/business/README.md#domain-principles]

## Domain Principles

Based on business architecture and value delivery principles:

- **Business-Driven**: Technology serves business objectives
- **Value Stream Focus**: Optimize end-to-end value delivery
- **Capability-Based**: Architecture organized around business capabilities
- **Customer-Centric**: Design for customer experience and outcomes
- **Measurable Outcomes**: Define and track business metrics
- **Agile Delivery**: Iterative capability development
page_texts.15:
[patterns/business/README.md#customer-onboarding]

## Customer Onboarding

The Customer Onboarding pattern addresses healthcare customer integration:
page_texts.16:
[patterns/business/README.md#pattern-overview]

### Pattern Overview

- **Purpose**: Streamline customer integration and data exchange
- **Context**: Healthcare organizations integrating with Gainwell platforms
- **Solution**: Event-driven onboarding workflow with automated provisioning
page_texts.17:
[patterns/business/README.md#key-capabilities]

### Key Capabilities

- Customer registration and validation
- Access provisioning and credential management
- Data exchange configuration (HL7, FHIR, EDI)
- Testing and certification workflows
- Go-live support and monitoring
page_texts.18:
[patterns/business/README.md#business-outcomes]

### Business Outcomes

- Reduced time-to-value for new customers
- Standardized onboarding experience
- Automated provisioning reduces manual effort
- Improved customer satisfaction
